title: feat: Timeline/Gantt UI optimization — cva variants, accessibility, mobile date badge
body:
Timeline view has poor information density, no semantic status colors on markers, missing aria-labels on Gantt toolbar icons, and hidden date metadata on mobile. ### `plugin-timeline` — cva-based variants - **TimelineItem**: `density` prop via `cva` — `default` (mb-10), `compact` (mb-3), `comfortable` (mb-6) - **TimelineMarker**: semantic color variants via `cva` — adds `todo`, `in-progress`, `done` alongside existing `success`/`warning`/`danger`/`info`. Migrated from manual class map to proper `cva` pattern. Updated palette from gray/green/yellow to emerald/amber/slate/purple. ```tsx ... ``` ### `plugin-gantt` — accessibility & mobile - Added `aria-label` to nav buttons (`Previous period`, `Next period`) and zoom buttons (`Zoom out`, `Zoom in`) - Added inline date badge (`sm:hidden`) below task title so mobile users see `start → end` when date columns are hidden via `hidden sm:block` ### Tests - 16 new tests for timeline density/marker variants - 5 new tests for GanttView aria-labels and mobile date badge
Original prompt Based on a thorough analysis of the screenshot and the existing codebase, here is a comprehensive UI optimization evaluation for the **Timeline view** of the "Project Task" screen in ObjectUI. --- ## 🔍 UI Optimization Evaluation — `Project Task` Timeline View (Mobile) > **Analyzed against:** `packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx`, `packages/plugin-list/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx`, `packages/plugin-timeline/src/index.tsx` --- ### 📊 Summary of Issues | Area | Severity | Issue | |---|---|---| | **Timeline — No Bars Visible** | 🔴 Critical | Timeline view shows only text labels, no date bars/visualization | | **View Switcher — Overflow** | 🟠 High | 4 tabs ("All Tasks", "Board", "Gantt", "Timeline") likely overflow on narrow screens | | **Task Rows — Too Sparse** | 🟠 High | Huge vertical gaps between task items — poor information density | | **Status Indicators** | 🟠 High | Half-circle markers carry no semantic color — status is invisible | | **Toolbar Icons** | 🟡 Medium | Filter/Sort toolbar icons are unlabeled and cryptic on mobile | | **Empty Columns** | 🟡 Medium | Start/End dates hidden (`hidden sm:block`) — no temporal data on mobile | | **Accessibility** | 🟡 Medium | No `aria-label` on filter/sort icons; no focus rings visible | | **Bottom Nav Truncation** | 🟢 Low | "Opportuni..." is truncated — tab labels need responsive handling | --- ### 🔴 Issue 1: Timeline View Has No Visual Timeline Bars **Root cause in code:** ```tsx name=GanttView.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b15ee60703c1de43fd341246c43ae10f7c0f02a1/packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx#L334-L357 {/* Right Side: Timeline */}
``` The Timeline view tab (visible in screenshot) appears to render the `plugin-timeline` **vertical variant**, which renders as a plain list. The **Gantt bars** (the actual horizontal time representation) are in `GanttView.tsx` under the "Gantt" tab — but the "Timeline" tab currently maps to the vertical `Timeline` component. The user sees a bare text list with no time visualization. **Fix:** When in the "Timeline" listView, render the `plugin-gantt` `GanttView` with `viewMode="week"` or use the `plugin-timeline`'s `variant="horizontal"` with proper date binding. The schema config in `objectstack.config.ts` should distinguish them properly: ```typescript name=objectstack.config.ts url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b15ee60703c1de43fd341246c43ae10f7c0f02a1/examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts#L60-L91 timeline: { name: 'timeline', label: 'Timeline', type: 'timeline', // currently renders vertical list — needs gantt bars ... } ``` **Recommended fix:** Map the "Timeline" tab to `GanttView` with `viewMode="month"` and make the `variant` configurable via schema. --- ### 🟠 Issue 2: View Switcher Overflows on Narrow Screens **Root cause in code:** ```tsx name=ViewSwitcher.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b15ee60703c1de43fd341246c43ae10f7c0f02a1/packages/plugin-list/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx#L42-L71 const VIEW_LABELS: Record = { grid: 'Grid', kanban: 'Kanban', ... timeline: 'Timeline', gantt: 'Gantt', }; ``` With 4 labeled tabs ("All Tasks", "Board", "Gantt", "Timeline") on a ~390px mobile screen, the tabs cannot fit without wrapping or truncation. The current switcher has no mobile-collapse behavior. **Recommended fix — icon-only on mobile with label tooltip:** ```tsx name=ViewSwitcher.tsx // Show icon-only on mobile, icon + label on sm+ ``` Or use a ` dropdown; Desktop: tab strip {isMobile ? ( ) : ( )} ``` --- ### 🟠 Issue 3: Massive Vertical Gaps — Low Information Density The screenshot shows ~120px of vertical space per task. The `plugin-timeline` vertical variant uses `mb-10 ml-6`: ```tsx name=index.tsx url=https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b15ee60703c1de43fd341246c43ae10f7c0f02a1/packages/plugin-timeline/src/index.tsx#L23-L33 const TimelineItem = React.forwardRef< HTMLLIElement, React.HTMLAttributes >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  • )) ``` **Recommended fix:** Reduce `mb-10` to `mb-3` (12px) for the Timeline variant w...
